KYS.Library.Pdf Documentation Welcome to KYS.Library.Pdf, an add-on to KYS.Library for working with PDF documents in internal .NET applications. It converts HTML (with custom fonts) to PDF, exports a DataTable to a PDF table, and checks, locks, or unlocks password-protected PDF files. This site contains a high-level overview of the library and a full API reference automatically generated from XML documentation comments. 📦 Project Modules KYS.Library.Pdf.Helpers Includes the helper classes for PDF generation and manipulation: PdfHelper ConvertHtmlToPdf – renders HTML to a PDF MemoryStream, with options to register standard, shipped, system, and custom (.ttf) font families. IsPasswordProtected – checks whether a PDF (as byte[] or PdfReader) requires a password. LockPdfDocument / UnlockPdfDocument – encrypts a PDF with owner/user passwords (AES-128) or decrypts it with the owner password. PdfDataTableHelper WriteToPdfFile – writes a DataTable into a PDF table with optional header and body styles, returning a Result. ⚡ Quick Example using KYS.Library.Pdf.Helpers; // HTML to PDF using only a custom font family using MemoryStream pdf = PdfHelper.ConvertHtmlToPdf( "

Hello

", registerStandardPdfFonts: false, registerShippedFonts: false, registerSystemFonts: false, importCustomFontFamilyFilePaths: new List { "fonts/Montserrat-Regular.ttf" }); // Protect a PDF with a password byte[] locked = PdfHelper.LockPdfDocument(pdf.ToArray(), ownerPass: "owner", userPass: "user"); // DataTable to PDF Result table = DataTableHelper.WriteToPdfFile(dataTable); ⚠️ Third-party License This library is built on iText 7 (itext7, itext7.pdfhtml), which is licensed under AGPL. A commercial license is available from iText for closed-source use. 🚀 Using This Library (Internal Use) Since this library is not currently published to NuGet, it can be consumed by: Cloning or downloading the repository Building the solution Locating the generated DLLs under: KYS.Library.Pdf/bin/Debug/net8.0/ or KYS.Library.Pdf/bin/Release/net8.0/ Adding the DLL references to your project manually (KYS.Library.Pdf depends on KYS.Library, so reference both): In Visual Studio: Project → Add Reference → Browse → Select DLLs In .NET CLI-based project: path/to/KYS.Library.dll path/to/KYS.Library.Pdf.dll Adding the third-party NuGet packages used by the library: itext7, itext7.pdfhtml, and CSharpFunctionalExtensions. 📘 API Reference Detailed class, method, and property documentation is available under the API section of this site.
